text: LXXVII. 1. Sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato vinayadharo sobhati. Katamehi sattahi? 2. Āpattiṃ jānāti, anāpattiṃ jānāti, lakukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, vinaye kho pana ṭhito hoti asaṃhiro, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ . . . pe . . . akasiralābhī, āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati. [page 143] LXXVIII. 1-LXXIX. 2 Vinaya-Vagga. 143 Imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato vinayadharo sobhatī ti.
